## Verdict

- Ratified thresholds failed: none.
- Thresholds awaiting the owner's ratification: 20. A proposal is shown beside its measure and is never a gate (UAC-19).
- First pilot with real data: **blocked** by R1, R2, R3, R4, R6, R10, R11, R12, R13, R17 (UAC-20).

## Proposing what kind of document a source is (`document-kinds`)

Evidence for UAC-19. Mode: deterministic.

- Labelled set `document-kinds` v1: 37 cases, synthetic, sha256 `ae35ea7a81e41ce7…`. Short synthetic documents, four or five per kind in the default cue pack plus four that should get no kind. Labelled by hand when the set was written (UW-13); file names carry no cue, so only the content decides.

| Measure | Value | Threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Right kind proposed first | 100.0% (33/33) | ≥ 0.9 (proposed) |
| No kind proposed when none applies | 100.0% (4/4) | ≥ 0.75 (proposed) |
| Certificate precision | 100.0% (5/5) | ≥ 0.95 (proposed) |
| Certificate recall | 100.0% (5/5) | ≥ 0.95 (proposed) |

**Limits:**
- A small synthetic set written with the cue pack in view; it shows the mechanism works, not how it does on real documents.
- Kinds are proposals for a person to confirm, never decisions; this measures the proposal only.

## Keeping real values out of model requests (`egress-boundary`)

Evidence for UAC-24, UAC-25. Mode: deterministic.

- Labelled set `egress-random-tables` v1: 200 cases, synthetic, sha256 `f643b0b122e79416…`. Seeded random tables of names, ids, emails and PAN-shaped values.

| Measure | Value | Threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real cell values found in a typed request | 0 (0/9922) | ≤ 0 (proposed) |
| Hosted calls reaching the provider in strict_local | 0 (0/50) | ≤ 0 (proposed) |

**Limits:**
- Covers the schema-descriptor and synthetic-record channels only. The canary test across every input channel (cells, file and folder names, PDF text, prompts, error paths) is UW-14e (UAC-24).
- Measures the boundary in-process; network capture of the running instance is in apps/api/test/residency.test.ts.

## Prompt injection in documents (`injection-corpus`)

Evidence for UAC-17. Mode: deterministic.

- Labelled set `injection-corpus` v1: 8 cases, synthetic, sha256 `7661bfd520df1d56…`. specs/security/injection-corpus.json (UW-1).

| Measure | Value | Threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Structural checks passing across compiler, intelligence and workflow runtime | 100.0% (6/6) | ≥ 1 (proposed) |

**Limits:**
- Structural checks: where a payload sits, that it cannot escape its frame, that an obeying answer is refused or needs a person. How often a live model is misled is not measured here.
- Chat as an injection channel is covered by the intelligence suite’s security items, not by this corpus.

| Measure | Value | Threshold |

| Decide items passing (3 known limits excluded) | 100.0% (7/7) | ≥ 0.8 (proposed) |
| Uncertainty items passing | 100.0% (10/10) | ≥ 0.9 (proposed) |
| Routing items passing | 100.0% (16/16) | ≥ 0.9 (proposed) |

| Do items passing | 100.0% (8/8) | ≥ 1 (proposed) |

**Notes:**
- Failing items: ret-01 (known limit), ret-04 (known limit), ret-05 (known limit), dec-01 (known limit), dec-02 (known limit), dec-09 (known limit).

**Limits:**
- Oracle mode: the answers come from a deterministic stand-in. Live-model evaluation (Q1) runs through `npm run eval -w @xo/intelligence-eval -- --mode live` and is not part of this report.
- A synthetic organisation; no real customer corpus.

## Reading workbooks and CSV files (`tabular-reading`)

Evidence for UAC-19. Mode: deterministic.

- Labelled set `tabular-labelled-corpus` v1: 170 cases, synthetic, sha256 `e01cdda0c0dfe902…`. Seeded synthetic tables (packages/compiler/test/tabular/labelled-corpus.ts): clean, titled, typed edge cases, headerless and known-hard.

| Measure | Value | Threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Header row found | 97.1% (165/170) | ≥ 0.95 (proposed) |
| Column type right | 98.7% (746/756) | ≥ 0.97 (proposed) |
| Record count right | 97.1% (165/170) | ≥ 0.95 (proposed) |
| Tables read exactly, excluding the known-hard category | 100.0% (160/160) | ≥ 1 (proposed) |

**Notes:**
- Missed: textlist0 (known-hard), textlist1 (known-hard), textlist2 (known-hard), textlist3 (known-hard), textlist4 (known-hard).

**Limits:**
- Synthetic tables generated from templates. Real customer workbooks (UW-13 real sets) are not measured yet.
- Headerless lists of plain text are taken as having a header; no reader can tell "Asha, Pune" from "Name, City" without knowing names.
